name: arrayEach
description: call the given UDF/Closure with every value in the array.
syntax: arrayEach( array array, function closure, [boolean parallel], [number maxThreads] )

params.name: closure
params.description:
A closure function (UDF) with the following signature:

`function(el, idx, arr){}`

Which is called for each item in the array.

Where `el` is the element (or item) of the array, `idx` is the index position of that element, and `arr` is a reference to the base array upon which the arrayEach function is called.

params.name: maxThreads
params.description: maximum number of threads executed, ignored when argument "parallel" is set to false
